content:
alejandro: Hey @eng-security — I pushed a small PR that changes how service tokens are minted for on-prem deployments. Need a quick security read: secrets scope, KMS usage, and egress implications. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4921 :pleading_face:
jess: On it. Can you paste the exact diff that touches the vault/role so we can eyeball the scope change?
alejandro: sure, pasted below
```diff
- role: onprem-service
- scopes: [read]
+ role: onprem-service
+ scopes: [read,write,decrypt]
+ kms_key: projects/example/locations/global/keyRings/onprem/cryptoKeys/onprem-ingest
```
mike: quick question — why add `decrypt`? do we have a KMS reachable from customer VPCs? this might create outbound callouts which need review.
sarah: if this ends up calling a cloud KMS from customer-managed VPC, we'll need an egress allowlist and peering review. Is the call from control-plane or the onprem node?
alejandro: it's from the customer-managed node (the onprem agent) -> it calls our central KMS proxy. We currently planned private peering but that isn't in the initial PR.
jess: OK. From a principle of least privilege, can we reduce scope: use `decrypt` only for bootstrap and issue short-lived tokens? Also add explicit audit tags.
paul: sec-bot flagged this branch: `high: external-kms-egress` — please attach the scan output in the PR so reviewers see the risk.
alejandro: attaching the scan snippet here:
```
sec-scan: external-kms-egress: true
recommendation: configure private-peering or use regional HSM/proxy
```
mike: timeline? if this blocks a release we should gate merge until peering is configured, or flip this behind an opt-in feature flag that is off by default.
alejandro: target is this week. Proposal: conditional merge with requirements — (1) short TTL tokens, (2) scoped role limited to decrypt on bootstrap, (3) a ticket to add peering before prod rollout.
jess: I can +1 conditionally. Please create a tracking ticket and add `security/needs-egress-review` label on the PR. Update the PR description with TTL and audit plan.
sarah: and add a note to onprem install docs requiring customers to configure NAT/proxy or private peering if they receive the KMS calls.
alejandro: done — PR description updated, ticket RED-2318 created: https://tracker.internal/RED-2318, label added. thanks all :rocket:
jess: +1 from sec (conditional) after the ticket and TTL are in place. move to merge queue with the condition.
paul: leaving a comment to run a quick smoke test for token rotation post-merge.
alejandro: will run smoke and follow up in RED-2318. Appreciate the quick review :thumbsup:
